req.title: Basic-auth rejects missing header
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 401 when the Authorization header is entirely absent from a request to /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd>.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> must return HTTP 401 when the Authorization header is entirely absent. We need: (1) a positive test confirming valid Basic Auth credentials yield HTTP 200 with correct JSON payload, (2) a negative test confirming absent Authorization header yields exactly HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate header, (3) a boundary test confirming a malformed/empty Authorization header (present but invalid) also yields 401, and (4) additional tests to kill mutations on the boolean logic in check_basic_auth (auth and auth.username == user and auth.password == passwd) and the exact status code constant 401. We test both sides of every comparison and assert exact values throughout.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_valid_credentials_returns_200
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/testuser/testpass with correct Basic Auth header
expected: JSON body contains authenticated=true and user='testuser'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-020: positive path — valid credentials must yield 200
Catches mutations: status_code(401) -> status_code(200), boolean negation of check_basic_auth
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_basic_auth_valid_credentials_returns_200():
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'testuser:testpass').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/testuser/testpass',
        headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'testuser'

test_basic_auth_valid_credentials_returns_200()

tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_basic_auth_correct_user_in_response_matches_path_param():
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'carol:xyz').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/carol/xyz',
        headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['user'] == 'carol'
    assert data['user'] != 'user'
    assert data['authenticated'] == True

test_basic_auth_correct_user_in_response_matches_path_param()
